summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of session data decoding during the transition to Django 3.1 by using a legacy encoding format when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is set to 'sha1'. However, the patch introduces a new conditional block that may introduce behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new conditional block that may introduce behavioral regression risk. It is unclear how this change will affect existing sessions and whether it will work correctly in all scenarios.
